name: ToadMark
description: The shared toad-family design language: one brand palette, one metric scale, one motion character across toadGALLERY, toadHEALTH and toadPLAYER.

provenance.brandPalette: toadPLAYER ToadTheme — dukeoftoad/toadPLAYER LGPL-3.0-only (zarzet); values re-expressed from toad_theme.dart, no code copied
provenance.accents: toadHEALTH ToadColors — dukeoftoad/toadHEALTH MIT (dukeoftoad); values from lib/theme.dart
provenance.metrics: toadPLAYER AppTokens.standard — LGPL-3.0-only (zarzet); values from app_tokens.dart
provenance.springs: Tuned Compose spring() presets that follow the M3-Expressive spatial/effects split (spatial overshoots slightly, effects settle flat); material_3_expressive package values are not copied

type.policy: headline and title roles carry the brand family (rounded terminals, bold weights); body and label roles carry the neutral family (crisp cut terminals). Families stay app-side: toadGALLERY keeps its Appearance font picker.
